chapter.verse: Kong itte aw, hih kamciamte nei i hih manin pumpi leh kha a thanghuaisak thei thu namkimte pan ei-le-ei kisiansuahin Pasian kihtakna tawh sianthona thu a cingtaak suaksak ni.
Kuamah' tungah hong khial lo, kuamah hong siatpih lo, kuamah hong metbawl lo ka hih manun kote na lungsim sung uhah mun hong pia un.
Note hong mawhsak nuamin hih bang hong gen ka hikei hi. A hang pen tuma-in kong gen khit mah bangin note tawh a sikhawm a hingkhawm nuam zahin ka lungsim sung uhah note na om uh hi.
Note' vai ah lungsim hanna lianpi tawh kong gamta a, note' hangin ka angtang hi. Noptuamna tawh ka kidim a, komau' gimthuakna citeng ah zong a dimletin ka nuam hi.
A hang pen Macedonia gam ka tun ciang nangawnun ka pumpi uh tawlnga kha lo-in a pualam ah kitotna, a sunglam ah launa cih teng tawh a namkimin gim ka tuak uh hi.
Ahih hangin a lungkia mite a hehnem Pasian in Titus hong tunsakna tawh kote hong hehnem hi.

Kei nong muhnopna uh, kei' ading na thum na tauna uh, kei' ading na thalawpna uh, cih thute Titus in kote' kiangah hong gen ciangin ama' hong tunna hang bek hilo-in note' kiangpana a ngah hehnepna thu hangin ka lungdam semsem hi.

A hang pen kong laikhak tawh note hong dahsak ka hi phial zongin—tua laikhak in tawmvei sung bek hitaleh note hong dahsak cih ka theih manin ka lungnopmawh a, ahi zongin—tu-in lungnopmawhin ka om kei hi.
Tu-a pen na dah manun a lungdam ka hikei a, dahin kisik na hih man uh hizaw hi. Kote' hangin bangmah na suplawh loh nadingun Pasian' zia bangin a dah na hi uh hi.
Pasian' zia banga dahna in kisikna piangsak a, tua in hotkhiatna hong tun ahih manin lungnopmawh nading om lo hi. Leitung paizia banga dahna ahihleh sihna piangsak hi.

A hang pen hih banga Pasian' zia tawh a kituak dahna thu in na sung uhah thulela kinna, tua banah kihutna, tua banah lunghamna, tua banah launa, tua banah lunggulhna, tua banah thalawpna, tua banah gawtna, cihte bangzah tak hong piangsak cih en dih un! Hih thu tawh kisai-in na khempeuh ah note mawhbaanglo na hihlam uh nomaumah na kipulak khin uh hi.
Tua hi a, lai kong khak hangin khialhna a bawlmi' ading zong hilo, a thuakmi' ading zong hilo-in kote' taangin kinna lungsim na neih uh Pasian' mai-ah a kilat nading hizaw hi.
Tua hangin lungsim ka noptuam uh hi. Ka ngah uh lungsim noptuamna banah na vekun Titus a kha tawldam thadimsak na hih manun ama' lungdamna hangin ka nuamzaw sem uh hi.

A hang pen ama' kianga note kong kisialhpih thute' hangin maizumna ka tuak kei hi. Note' kianga kong gen khempeuh uh a maan ahih zah khatin Titus' mai-a ka kisialh uh pen zong maan ahihna kilang khin hi.
Titus in na vekun thu na manna uh ahi zongin, zahtakna lianpi tawh amah na sanna uh ahi zongin tuate phawkin note hong lainatna khang semsem hi.
Note na khempeuh ah kong muan theih ka lungdam hi.
